text:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — proposing a "split-the-delta" plan for SSO/SCIM vs. MVP surface. Idea: ship a minimal, self-serve SSO admin UX in MVP (email-federation + OIDC basics) and timebox enterprise SAML/SCIM/OOB provisioning to v1. Thoughts?

Alex (Eng): +1 to timebox. Implementation note: we can gate enterprise features behind a flag and a dedicated routing path. For MVP we can support OIDC + SSO metadata upload, but skip SCIM automation. Rough eng effort: 2 engineers, ~6w for MVP bits, +8w for full SCIM/SAML work.

Sam (Eng-runtime): Runtime impact: OIDC + simple SSO handshake is lightweight. Full SAML + SCIM needs KMS integration for service principal rotation and audit trails — that's v1. For MVP we can use short-lived keys and additional logging.

Ben (Design): For admin UX keep it to two flows: "Connect SSO" (OIDC) and "Request Enterprise" (form). No SCIM controls in MVP. We can mock provisioning UI and mark "coming in v1" with a clear footnote.

Qi (CS): Several pilot customers asked specifically for SCIM provisioning. They'll accept a phased approach if we commit to a concrete v1 date and a pilot-only manual onboarding path for MVP. We need an explicit customer communications blurb.

Maya (PM): OK — decision directionally agreed. Proposed commitments:
- MVP: OIDC + metadata upload; admin connect flow; manual onboarding playbook for pilot customers.
- v1: SAML + SCIM + KMS-backed keys + audit logs.
Action items:
- Alex: feature-flag implementation + rough infra checklist (due 1711727134)
- Sam: runtime risk doc + KMS gating plan (due 1711727134)
- Ben: MVP admin UX draft + copy for "pilot onboarding" (due 1711380000)
- Qi: customer comm draft + list of pilots who need SCIM (due 1711380000)

Alex (Eng): I'll add the feature-flag toggle and a short config example:
```
feature_flags:
  sso_enterprise: false
```
We can flip per-customer when ready.

devops-bot: Deployment window scheduled: staging rollout 1711500000 -> canary 1711600000 -> prod 1711700000

Maya (PM): Great. One more ask — can we set a firm milestone check at +3 weeks to decide if anything needs to be pulled into MVP? If so, we'll communicate that checkpoint to stakeholders and pilots.

Sam (Eng-runtime): Yes, 3-week checkpoint works for runtime gating. We'll surface any blockers early.

Qi (CS): I'll prep the customer note and flag any pilots that won't accept manual onboarding.

Maya (PM): Perfect. I'll update the milestone tracker and add this thread as the scope decision record. :white_check_mark:
